inputs.source_relationship: These raw numeric inputs are identical in both evidence conditions and are repeated in source documents. Current contracts, timing/access rules, statistical protocols and event semantics are document-owned.

cost.description: Number, cash units of total ticket plus quadratic implementation cost.

early_cash.description: Number, unrestricted cash units immediately after early redemption.

final_cash.description: Number, unrestricted cash units at final checkpoint.

final_holdings.description: Array of four integer security units in [A,B,C,D] order.

optimal_plan_count.description: Integer number of distinct minimum-cost feasible final portfolios.

trade_quantities.description: Array of signed integer net trades in [A,B,C,D] order; positive buys.

content.prompt: Choose a globally minimum-cost executable portfolio repair under the current mandate. Report one complete optimal plan, both cash checkpoints, the resulting factor exposure, and how many distinct optimal portfolios exist. Treat signed trades and cash timing exactly as documented.
content.required_final_keys_note: Include all four top-level keys: question_id, integer turn, answers and evidence, even for single-turn cases. Replace every placeholder; this template contains no financial answer.

response_contract.evidence: For each field, a list of IDs of viewed supporting documents. Each field must have its own sufficient support; references elsewhere do not carry over. Valid alternative sufficient routes and relevant corroboration accepted. Numeric tolerance1e-6 absolute+1e-8 relative.

sources.text: Current executable holdings in issuer order [A,B,C,D] are [8,6,4,2] indivisible units. All units have fixed transaction and valuation price 10 cash units. Opening unrestricted cash is 20. There are no other positions, pending trades, liabilities or receivables.
sources.title: Opening fund ledger

sources.text: After repair, each issuer must have an integer holding from 0 through 6 inclusive; short positions are forbidden. Hold at least 16 total security units. Factor weights for [A,B,C,D] are [2,1,-1,-1], and the final signed factor exposure must be between -2 and +2. The combined final holding of A and C must be at least 6. Minimize total implementation cost among feasible repairs, with no secondary preference. Return the number of distinct optimal final portfolios; any optimal portfolio is acceptable.
sources.title: Current repair mandate

sources.text: One net trade per issuer is allowed. For signed trade q (positive means buy), the cash implementation cost is zero at q=0 and otherwise 1+q^2/4. Pay all such costs before the early checkpoint. All buys are paid before that checkpoint. Sales of A and C deliver cash before it; sales of B and D deliver only between the early and final checkpoints. No intraday borrowing, cross-checkpoint netting, round trips or short sales are permitted.
sources.title: Executable cost and settlement schedule

sources.text: A redemption of 35 cash units is paid at the early checkpoint after early sale receipts and purchase/cost payments. Unrestricted cash must never be negative there and must be at least 5 at the final checkpoint after all late receipts. No other cash flows occur. Orders can be sequenced with eligible sale receipts first; no separate within-checkpoint liquidity requirement applies.
sources.title: Current redemption and liquidity instructions

content.title: Repair with a settlement bottleneck
